checkedAlternates.risk: px is classified as an absolute length in CSS.
checkedAlternates.resolution: While px is an absolute CSS unit, pt and cm are physical print-derived units (group-2), whereas px is the screen reference pixel (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: ch is less familiar than em/rem.
checkedAlternates.resolution: ch measures the advance width of the "0" glyph in the current font (group-3), not the viewport.
